To resolve this, I will enforce a strict hold-out validation split that remains completely unseen during training. Rather than relying on a brittle frequency lookup, I will fine-tune a lightweight T5 sequence-to-sequence model exclusively on the training portion, evaluate it once on the untouched validation set to compute a genuine accuracy score, and then deploy this validated model directly to generate predictions for the test set.
